answer: The hollow counter is kept in dune and mesa exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3222 identities would post 4241 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
